text:
Type: square light wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and plants; living room, small apartments
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: ash veneer top with visible striped grain, solid wood legs
Colors: pale blond ash, light warm wood
Shape: square top with softly rounded corners and a beveled edge, four slender tapered legs angled outward, compact and light
Feel: natural, calm, airy, friendly
Goes with: light grey or white sofas, rattan, green plants; Scandinavian or Japandi living rooms

product.name: LISABO
product.description: The table surface in ash veneer and legs in solid birch give a warm, natural feeling to your room
